description: Takes the outstanding balance, months left, current and new rates and a fee and returns both EMIs, the net saving and the break-even months of a balance transfer. Example input: {"outstanding":4000000,"remainingMonths":180,"currentRate":9.25,"newRate":8.4,"processingFee":20000}

newRate.description: New lender annual rate in percent

remainingMonths.description: Months left on the current loan

name: balanceTransfer
